# Asif Ghayaz

> Asif Ghayaz (born 1972) is a Karachi-based Pakistani artist known for finely rendered pen-and-ink drawings, landscape paintings and Islamic calligraphy. He trained under Eqbal Mehdi, has exhibited across Pakistan, and his work has been used in institutional publications. This website is his official portfolio. All artworks shown are original works by Asif Ghayaz.

## Key facts
- Artist: Asif Ghayaz, born 1972 in Karachi, based in Karachi, Pakistan
- Mediums: pen and ink, painting, Islamic calligraphy, mixed media
- Subjects: portraits, horses, architecture, landscapes, still life, abstract work
- Trained under: Eqbal Mehdi
- Exhibiting since: the early 1990s
- Selected exhibitions: "Chromatic Fields" (solo, June 2024); "Material Echoes" (group, November 2023)
- Publications: Contemporary Art Review (2024); AKUH publications
- Buying and commissions: by Contact form, email or WhatsApp; prices are shared on request
- Studio visits: by appointment
- Also shown through galleries: Art Citi (https://artciti.com/shop-by-artist/asif-ghayaz), Oyster Art Gallery (https://oysterartgalleries.com/artist/statement-asif-ghayaz-63), Art Bliss Gallery (https://www.artblissgallery.com/artist/Asif-Ghayaz)
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/asifghayaz/ · https://www.facebook.com/asif.ghayaz/

## Galleries
- [Home and overview](https://asifghayaz.com/): featured work, about the artist, FAQ and contact
- [Masterpieces](https://asifghayaz.com/master): large pen-and-ink masterpiece works
- [Pen & ink drawings](https://asifghayaz.com/regular): portraits and everyday pen-and-ink drawings
- [Horse art](https://asifghayaz.com/horses): pen-and-ink horse studies
- [Architectural drawings](https://asifghayaz.com/architecture/): historic buildings and arches in pen and ink
- [Landscape paintings](https://asifghayaz.com/landscape): landscape paintings
- [Islamic calligraphy](https://asifghayaz.com/calligraphy): original calligraphy compositions in Arabic script
- [Other artworks](https://asifghayaz.com/other): still life and abstract paintings
